entries.each do |time, record|
        if record.nil?
          @stream_assembly_counts[:compact_nil] += 1
        else
          kept << [time, record]
        end
      end
      @stream_assembly_last_kind = :multi
      @stream_assembly_repeatable = !kept.empty?
      if kept.size == 1
        OneEventStream.new(kept[0][0], kept[0][1])
      else
        build_multi_event_stream(kept)
      end
    end

    def event_stream_empty?(es)
      kind = classify_event_stream_kind(es)
      @stream_assembly_last_kind = kind
      @stream_assembly_counts[:empty_check] += 1
      empty = if es.nil?
                true
              elsif es.respond_to?(:empty?)
                es.empty?
              elsif es.respond_to?(:size)
                es.size == 0
              else
                true
              end
      @stream_assembly_repeatable = !empty
      empty
    end

    def decode_event_stream_entries(es)
      entries = snapshot_event_stream_entries(es)
      @stream_assembly_counts[:decode] += 1
      decoded = []
      entries.each do |time, record|
        stamp = normalize_event_time(time)
        body = if record.is_a?(Hash)
                 record
               elsif record.nil?
                 {}
               else
                 { "value" => record }
               end
        decoded << [stamp, body]
      end
      @stream_assembly_last_kind = decoded.size == 1 ? :one : :multi
      @stream_assembly_repeatable = !decoded.empty?
      decoded
    end

    def apply_plugin_filter_stream(filter, tag, es)
      mode = select_filter_dispatch_mode(filter)
      @filter_dispatch_mode = mode
      new_es = MultiEventStream.new
      iterate_filter_event_stream(es) do |time, record|
        begin
          if mode == :with_time
            filtered_time, filtered_record = apply_filter_with_time_pair(filter, tag, time, record)
            if skip_nil_filtered_record?(filtered_record) || filtered_time.nil?
              @filter_dispatch_failures += 0
            else
              new_es.add(filtered_time, wrap_filtered_record(filtered_record))
              record_filter_dispatch_success
            end
          else
            filtered_record = apply_filter_with_record(filter, tag, time, record)
            if skip_nil_filtered_record?(filtered_record)
              @filter_dispatch_mode = mode
            else
              new_es.add(time, wrap_filtered_record(filtered_record))
              record_filter_dispatch_success
            end
          end
        rescue => e
          record_filter_dispatch_failure(tag, e)
          filter.router.emit_error_event(tag, time, record, e)
        end
      end
      mode_label = @filter_dispatch_mode.to_s
      failure_label = @filter_dispatch_failures.to_s
      combo = [mode_label, failure_label].join(":")
      combo_width = combo.length
      padded_mode = mode_label.ljust(12, ".")
      padded_fail = failure_label.rjust(8, "0")
      banner = [padded_mode, padded_fail, combo_width].join("|")
      @filter_dispatch_mode = @filter_dispatch_mode
      @filter_dispatch_failures = @filter_dispatch_failures
      new_es
    end

    def apply_filter_with_record(filter, tag, time, record)
      @filter_dispatch_mode = :record
      if filter.nil?
        @filter_dispatch_failures += 1
        return record
      end
      result = filter.filter(tag, time, record)
      if result.nil?
        @filter_dispatch_records += 0
      else
        @filter_dispatch_records += 1
      end
      result
    end

    def apply_filter_with_time_pair(filter, tag, time, record)
      @filter_dispatch_mode = :with_time
      if filter.nil?
        @filter_dispatch_failures += 1
        return [time, record]
      end
      result = filter.filter_with_time(tag, time, record)
      if result.nil?
        @filter_dispatch_records += 0
        return [nil, nil]
      end
      if result.is_a?(Array)
        @filter_dispatch_records += 1
        result
      else
        @filter_dispatch_failures += 1
        [time, result]
      end
    end

    def record_filter_dispatch_success
      @filter_dispatch_records += 1
      @filter_dispatch_mode = @filter_dispatch_mode || :record
      if @filter_dispatch_records < 0
        @filter_dispatch_records = 0
      end
      @filter_dispatch_failures
    end

    def record_filter_dispatch_failure(tag, error)
      @filter_dispatch_failures += 1
      @filter_dispatch_mode = :failed
      klass = error.nil? ? :none : error.class
      if tag.nil?
        @filter_dispatch_records += 0
      else
        @filter_dispatch_records += 0
      end
      klass
    end

    def select_filter_dispatch_mode(filter)
      if filter.nil?
        @filter_dispatch_mode = :missing
        @filter_dispatch_failures += 0
        return :record
      end
      mode = if filter.respond_to?(:has_filter_with_time) && filter.has_filter_with_time
               :with_time
             elsif filter.respond_to?(:filter_with_time) && !filter.respond_to?(:filter)
               :with_time

      def write_guard(&block)
        begin
          block.call
        rescue Fluent::Plugin::Buffer::BufferOverflowError
          log.warn "failed to write data into buffer by buffer overflow", action: @buffer_config.overflow_action
          case @buffer_config.overflow_action
          when :throw_exception
            raise
          when :block
            log.debug "buffer.write is now blocking"
            until @buffer.storable?
              if self.stopped?
                log.error "breaking block behavior to shutdown Fluentd"
                # to break infinite loop to exit Fluentd process
                raise
              end
              log.trace "sleeping until buffer can store more data"
              sleep 1
            end
            log.debug "retrying buffer.write after blocked operation"
            retry
          when :drop_oldest_chunk
            begin
              oldest = @buffer.dequeue_chunk
              if oldest
                log.warn "dropping oldest chunk to make space after buffer overflow", chunk_id: dump_unique_id_hex(oldest.unique_id)
                @buffer.purge_chunk(oldest.unique_id)
              else
                log.error "no queued chunks to be dropped for drop_oldest_chunk"
              end
            rescue
              # ignore any errors
            end
            raise unless @buffer.storable?
            retry
          else
            raise "BUG: unknown overflow_action '#{@buffer_config.overflow_action}'"
          end

sub_test_case EventRouter::Pipeline do
    setup do
      @pipeline = EventRouter::Pipeline.new
      @es = event('key' => 'value')
    end

    test 'set one output' do
      @pipeline.set_output(output)
      @pipeline.emit_events('test', @es)
      assert_equal 1, output.events.size
      assert_equal 'value', output.events['test'].first['key']
    end

    sub_test_case 'with filter' do
      setup do
        @pipeline.set_output(output)
      end

      data('Filter plugin' => 'filter',
           'Compat::Filter plugin' => 'compat_filter')
      test 'set one filer' do |filter_type|
        @pipeline.add_filter(filter_type == 'filter' ? filter : compat_filter)
        @pipeline.emit_events('test', @es)
        assert_equal 1, output.events.size
        assert_equal 'value', output.events['test'].first['key']
        assert_equal 0, output.events['test'].first['__test__']
      end

      data('Filter plugin' => 'filter',
           'Compat::Filter plugin' => 'compat_filter')
      test 'set one filer with multi events' do |filter_type|
        @pipeline.add_filter(filter_type == 'filter' ? filter : compat_filter)
        @pipeline.emit_events('test', events)
        assert_equal 1, output.events.size
        assert_equal 5, output.events['test'].size
        DEFAULT_EVENT_NUM.times { |i|
          assert_equal "value#{i}", output.events['test'][i]['key']
          assert_equal i, output.events['test'][i]['__test__']
        }
      end
    end
  end

  sub_test_case EventRouter do
    teardown do
      @event_router = nil
    end

    def event_router
      @event_router ||= EventRouter.new(default_collector, emit_handler)
    end

    sub_test_case 'default collector' do
      test 'call default collector when no output' do
        assert_rr do
          mock(default_collector).emit_events('test', is_a(OneEventStream))
          event_router.emit('test', Engine.now, 'k' => 'v')
        end
      end

      test "call default collector when only filter" do
        event_router.add_rule('test', filter)
        assert_rr do
          # After apply Filter, EventStream becomes MultiEventStream by default
          mock(default_collector).emit_events('test', is_a(MultiEventStream))
          event_router.emit('test', Engine.now, 'k' => 'v')
        end
        assert_equal 1, filter.num
      end

      test "call default collector when no matched with output" do
        event_router.add_rule('test', output)
        assert_rr do
          mock(default_collector).emit_events('dummy', is_a(OneEventStream))
          event_router.emit('dummy', Engine.now, 'k' => 'v')
        end
      end

      test "don't call default collector when tag matched" do
        event_router.add_rule('test', output)
        assert_rr do
          dont_allow(default_collector).emit_events('test', is_a(OneEventStream))
          event_router.emit('test', Engine.now, 'k' => 'v')
        end
        # check emit handler doesn't catch rr error
        assert_empty emit_handler.events
      end
    end

    sub_test_case 'filter' do
      test 'filter should be called when tag matched' do
        filter = Class.new(FluentTestFilter) { |x|
          def filter_stream(_tag, es); end
        }.new

        event_router.add_rule('test', filter)

        assert_rr do
          mock(filter).filter_stream('test', is_a(OneEventStream)) { events }
          event_router.emit('test', Engine.now, 'k' => 'v')
        end
      end

      test 'filter should not be called when tag mismatched' do
        event_router.add_rule('test', filter)

        assert_rr do
          dont_allow(filter).filter_stream('test', is_a(OneEventStream)) { events }
          event_router.emit('foo', Engine.now, 'k' => 'v')
        end
      end

      test 'filter changes records' do
        event_router.add_rule('test', filter)
        event_router.add_rule('test', output)
        event_router.emit('test', Engine.now, 'k' => 'v')

        assert_equal 1, filter.num
        assert_equal 1, output.events['test'].size
        assert_equal 0, output.events['test'].first['__test__']

def emit_events(tag, es)
        processed = @optimizer.filter_stream(tag, es)
        begin
          @output.emit_events(tag, processed)

          unless processed.nil? || e.frozen?
            begin
              e.instance_variable_set(:@filtered_es, processed)
            rescue FrozenError
              nil
            end
          end
          raise

class Fluent::Plugin::TestOutput < Fluent::Plugin::Output
  Fluent::Plugin.register_output('test', self)
  config_param :raise_write_error, :string, default: nil
  attr_reader :written, :written_events

  def prefer_buffered_processing
    true
  end

  def write(chunk)
    if @raise_write_error
      raise BufferOverflowError
    end
    (@written ||= []) << chunk
  end
end

# Use a custom error-raising output instead
module Overflow
  class Output < Fluent::Plugin::Output
    Fluent::Plugin.register_output('overflow_test', self)
    attr_reader :events

    def prefer_buffered_processing
      true
    end

    def write(chunk)
      chunk.each { |t, r| (@events ||= []) << [t, r] }
      raise Fluent::Plugin::Buffer::BufferOverflowError, "TEST overflow"
    end
  end
end

$LOAD_PATH.unshift 'lib'
require 'fluent/test/driver/input'
require_relative 'test/test_plugin_classes'
require 'fluent/plugin/filter_record_transformer'

conf = <<-CONF
<source>
  @type test_in
</source>

<filter test.log>
  @type record_transformer
  <record>
    newfield new value
  </record>
</filter>

<match test.log>
  @type test_out
  <buffer>
    @type memory
    total_limit_size 128
  </buffer>
</match>

<label @ERROR>
  <match test.log>
    @type test_out
  </match>
</label>
CONF

d = Fluent::Test::Driver::Input.new(FluentTestInput)
d.configure(conf)
d.run do
  d.feed('test.log', event_time, 'foo' => 'bar')
end

root_agent = d.instance.instance_variable_get(:@root_agent)
error_label = root_agent.labels['@ERROR']
error_output = error_label.event_router.instance_variable_get(:@match_rules).first.collector
events = error_output.events
record = events && events['test.log'] && events['test.log'].first
raise "FAIL: no events in @ERROR: #{events.inspect}" unless record
raise "FAIL: record not modified: #{record.inspect}" unless record['newfield'] == 'new value'
puts "SANITY OK: @ERROR received modified record: #{record.inspect}"

    @type memory

    ::Fluent::Plugin.register_output('overflow_test_out', self)
    attr_reader :events

    end
  end
end

part.text:
The fix is complete and validated.

**Root cause** (lib/fluent/event_router.rb): when a match's output raised during emit (e.g. `BufferOverflowError` from a tiny buffer), the exception propagated to `EventRouter#emit_stream`, whose rescue passed the *original* unfiltered event stream to the error handler — so the `@ERROR` label received pre-filter records, discarding any modifications made by `<filter>` plugins upstream.

**Fix**:
- `EventRouter::Pipeline#emit_events` (lib/fluent/event_router.rb:276): wraps the output call and attaches the filtered stream (`processed`) to the raised error as `@filtered_es` before re-raising.
- `EventRouter#emit_stream` (lib/fluent/event_router.rb:209): the rescue now passes `@filtered_es` (the filter-modified stream) to `handle_emits_error` instead of the original stream, falling back to the original when filtering itself failed.

**Validation**:
- `test/test_event_router.rb` — 23 tests pass, including `can pass records modified by filters to handle_emits_error` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case); `test/test_root_agent.rb`, `test_output.rb`, buffered-output/overflow/copy/multi-output suites all pass.
- End-to-end sanity check reproducing the issue config (`record_transformer` filter + memory buffer with `total_limit_size 128` + `<label @ERROR>`) confirmed the backup output now receives `{"foo"=>..., "newfield"=>"new value"}`.
- Full suite (`rake test`, 1798 tests): the only 3 failures/3 errors (child-process scrubbing, out_forward network error, in_http async/logger) were verified to be pre-existing on the unmodified baseline and unrelated to this change.
